title: Jev is Vercel's fastest-adopted AI model ever | TechCrunch
summary: Vercel data published on Thursday shows that, within two weeks of its launch, the buzzy decision model was being used by 35% of paid teams, with nearly double the reach of the second most popular model, Sonnet 5.5.
